fact: The ITU repository lists Egypt Vision 2030 and the Digital Egypt Strategy as the country's strategy and says the countries it lists have adopted one; no adopting act is named, so this is dated by the repository's 2025 publication year.
The repository gives the time frame of Egypt Vision 2030 and the Digital Egypt Strategy as 2016 - ongoing.
The repository names the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology as lead/owner of Egypt Vision 2030 and the Digital Egypt Strategy.

At the Cairo ICT'24 opening the ICT minister briefed the Prime Minister on the Digital Egypt strategy's pillars (digital services, jobs in the digital economy, digital creativity, infrastructure) and gave implementation figures, including 8 million registered on the Digital Egypt platform and 23 of a targeted 32 creativity centres built; the figures are not presented as progress against the strategy's own targets.

At the first meeting of the reconstituted Supreme Council for Digital Society the Prime Minister named approval (إقرار) of the National strategy for building a fully digital state among the council's objectives; the report records no approval of it.
